TROLLfx Sweep Lab V0.5.4. Existing live RTA and saved sweep capture/analysis remain. Sweep results use one adjustable common relative-dB window around the smoothed 1 kHz response, 31-band LED clipping indicators, and a 256-sample log-frequency curve encoded by supported Image filmstrip frames. Range/center are reversible view controls. Six fractional-octave choices reprocess only the selected saved measurement. Raw capture/reference/impulse/response/phase data are preserved. Absolute SPL remains provisional. Keep Force playback on Internal Audio. See FORCE-NATIVE-V054-RESULTS.md and FORCE-NATIVE-V054-HARDWARE-TEST.md.
